extracted.intended_audience: readers interested in patent law developments (legal academics, practitioners, policy analysts, law students)
extracted.subtask_description: A short news summary reporting findings from an empirical study of patent litigation outcomes (cases filed 2008–2009, decided 2009–2013) and comparing them to earlier work; aimed at conveying high-level empirical results about win/loss rates. Not a guideline or rubric for drafting or evaluating patents.
